note.zh: 与“写作者”交流数周后得到一颗金色球体；探索结束，获得 3600 天的“一件礼物”修正与大量星界丝缕。
note.en: After weeks of exchange the Writer leaves a golden sphere; the exploration ends with the 3600-day modifier “A Gift” and a large astral thread reward.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 700–730 全部事件；两次二选一都汇合到同一结局，编译结构无误。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 700–730; both two-way choices converge on the single ending; the compiled structure is correct.
